# lightdash_ai_provider_credential (Resource)

Manages a named Amazon Bedrock BYOK credential at the organization level (the same credentials managed under organization AI provider settings in Lightdash).

Requires an organization admin personal access token. The `api_key` is never returned by the Lightdash API after creation; Terraform keeps the value you supplied in state until you change it. Import does not populate `api_key`—provide a new key and apply to rotate.

Setting `is_default` to `true` makes this credential the organization default via the Lightdash API. Lightdash only supports designating a default credential, not clearing the default through the API; set another credential as default instead.

If your organization still has a legacy Bedrock configuration, adopt it once with the Lightdash API (`POST /api/v1/ai/provider-credentials/adopt-legacy`) before managing credentials with Terraform.

`deletion_protection` is required. When set to `true`, Terraform will not destroy the resource. Imported resources default to `deletion_protection = true`.

Self-hosted instances must expose the AI provider credentials API (same as Lightdash Cloud). Instance-wide `BEDROCK_*` environment variables are not managed by this resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "lightdash_organization" "example" {
}

resource "lightdash_ai_provider_credential" "bedrock" {
  organization_uuid   = data.lightdash_organization.example.organization_uuid
  provider            = "bedrock"
  label               = "production-bedrock"
  region              = "us-east-1"
  allowed_models      = ["claude-sonnet-4-5"]
  inference_geography = "us"
  api_key             = var.bedrock_api_key
  is_default          = true
  deletion_protection = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ai_provider` (String) AI provider type. Currently only `bedrock` is supported.
- `allowed_models` (List of String) Model identifiers allowed for this credential.
- `deletion_protection` (Boolean) When set to `true`, prevents Terraform from destroying the credential.
- `label` (String) Display label for the credential.
- `organization_uuid` (String) The UUID of the Lightdash organization. Must match the organization for the configured API token.
- `region` (String) AWS region for Bedrock.

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) Bedrock API key or gateway bearer token. Required on create; optional on update to rotate.
- `inference_geography` (String) Bedrock inference geography (`jp`, `us`, `eu`, `apac`, `global`).
- `is_default` (Boolean) When true, sets this credential as the organization default after create or update.

### Read-Only

- `api_key_hint` (String) Hint of the stored API key from Lightdash.
- `credential_uuid` (String) UUID of the credential in Lightdash.
- `id` (String) Credential UUID.
